ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: reached a life goal
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has stood a little taller since {PAWN_pronoun} managed to {LABEL}.
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.defaultLabel: do what they set out to do

plain.li: I said I would {LABEL}, and I did. I'd like that written somewhere people will see it.
Done. I keep going over how I did it, the way you count coins twice.
People said I'd never {LABEL}. I'd like a list of their names.

cheerful.li: I set out to {LABEL}, and look at me now.

cold.li: The goal is reached. I had expected it to take longer.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: reached a life goal
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has looked further ahead since {PAWN_pronoun} managed to {LABEL}.
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.defaultLabel: do what they set out to do

plain.li: I managed to {LABEL}. I didn't think I would, most days. Now I wonder what else I could do.
It took longer than I thought and it was harder than I thought, and I did it anyway.
I keep catching myself smiling at nothing. It's because I managed to {LABEL}.

warm.li: I couldn't have done it without the others. I'll tell each of them so.

gloomy.li: I got there. I keep waiting for something to go wrong with it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: saw their idea built
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been readier with ideas since the colony took up {PAWN_possessive} plan for {LABEL} and finished it.

plain.li: It was my idea, {LABEL}, and now it's done and people use it. I keep walking past just to look.
I stood up at the meeting and said we should do it, and we did. I have three more ideas now.
The others thanked me for {LABEL} today. I said it was everyone's work, and it was, but I said it first.

warm.li: Everyone worked on it, not just me. But I said it first, and I'm allowed to be glad.

blunt.li: Told them we should. We did. It works.

gloomy.li: They built what I asked for. Now if it fails, everyone will know whose idea it was.

cold.li: The plan was sound and was carried out. I'll propose the next one sooner.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a custom of theirs kept for good
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been fonder of the colony's ways since {LABEL}, which {PAWN_pronoun} first asked for, became a tradition.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} first asked for {LABEL}, and now it's a tradition.

plain.li: Three years ago I asked for {LABEL}, once. Now it's a tradition, and the children think it was always here.
{LABEL} is ours for good now. I remember the evening I first asked for it, and how nervous I was.
We kept {LABEL} again, the third year running, and nobody asked whether we would.

warm.li: Something I asked for will go on after me. I didn't expect that to matter so much.

cheerful.li: My custom is a tradition. I'm going to pretend I planned it that way.

gloomy.li: A tradition now. One day somebody will forget why we do it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: kept their word in a seat
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has trusted the colony more since a year as {LABEL} with the promise {PAWN_pronoun} made kept.

plain.li: A year as {LABEL}, and I did what I said I would. The colony saw it too.
I promised when they voted me in, and the year showed I meant it. That's worth more to me than the seat.
A year ago I said what I would do as {LABEL}. Today the colony said I did it.

warm.li: They believed me a year ago, and I didn't let them down. I'm grateful they believed me.

cold.li: The promise is judged kept. It is a useful thing to have on the record.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a hard stretch that ended well
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been more hopeful since {LABEL} came to a good end.
